subject: Taxes
title: The Audit Lottery
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Audit Lottery.

hook.text: Your chance of being audited by the IRS is 0.4%—the lowest in 50 years.

buildup.text: The IRS lost 30% of its enforcement staff between 2010 and 2020 due to budget cuts. Fewer agents means fewer audits.

discovery.text: Low audit rates create a rational calculation: the expected penalty from cheating is tiny.

twist.text: Despite low odds, most people still pay honestly. Moral commitment overpowers the rational case for cheating.

climax.text: The audit rate is a signal. When it drops too low, it tells people the system isn't watching.

punchline.text: 0.4% audit chance. Compliance persists. But the signal is fading.

quiz.question: What is the current chance of being audited by the IRS?
